  1. Students must earn a \"C-\" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Child and Adolescent Development and the Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Early Childhood Education are compatible with the B.A. in Child and Adolescent Development - Educational Contexts concentration at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a \"C\" or better.
  3. For Child and Adolescent Development advising, please contact the department at (916) 278-6639.
  4. For additional information, please visit: Child and Adolescent Development.

This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State course son the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.
